changelog: Orion 3.5 — one fix: Home tells the truth. Your screenshot showed Home calling your own API "not connected" — that was the external boost's state pasted onto the built-in label, and it was wrong. Now the Home chip reads the real built-in state and says "Orion's API: built in • connected, always on" — the built-in core is part of the app and is never called not connected on any screen; the only other state it can show is "starting up" in the first moments after opening. The brain line leads with the truth in every case: "Running on your built-in API — connected, always on," with the chat route named after it. The Vault key is a boost and is framed that way only inside Settings/Vault and on the My API page — no "paste your key" line on Home, and no status line anywhere asks for a key. One honest note: "Skills: 0 learned" was a true count — the skills store starts empty and fills only when Orion learns from a correction or you teach it a skill; nothing was faked. New Terms section 6V states the status-line rules — the app will ask you to agree again, once.
